verdict.rationale: Marketing-page claims describe AI-driven suggestions built from the user's own data: a campaign agent that plans campaigns from brand, audience and past performance, and answer-engine visibility monitoring with 'clear next steps' to improve it. These are only one-line product-page claims with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration, and the analytics and dashboard evidence does not describe AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: documented AI insight or analytics assistant over reports and CRM data, depth of how suggestions are generated and surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
See how your brand shows up in answer engines, and get clear next steps to improve it.
Find high-potential prospects within your contact lists.
